parameters.help_en: The long namespace ID. If you specify this parameter, it takes effect and NameSpaceShortId is ignored. This parameter is retained for backward compatibility. We recommend that you use the short namespace ID. The format is `<RegionId>:<NamespaceId>`. `NamespaceId` can contain only lowercase letters and digits, such as `cn-beijing:test`. The value cannot exceed 32 characters in length. For more information about the RegionId values supported by SAE, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834842.html
parameters.help_zh: 长版命名空间ID。如果设置了该参数会继续生效而忽略NameSpaceShortId，为了兼容保留，推荐使用短版命名空间ID；格式为`<RegionId>:<NamespaceId>`，`NamespaceId`仅允许小写英文字母和数字，例如`cn-beijing:test`，不超过32个字符。SAE支持的RegionId，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834842.html

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the built-in registry of SAE. Valid values:
true
false

If you set this parameter to true, a shared registry and related information are created for the namespace. After the shared registry is created, it cannot be disabled

是否启用SAE内置注册中心：
true
false

若选择true，则将为该命名空间创建共享注册中心等相关信息，同时创建后无法关闭
